answer.rationale: Expiry in 14 days with no auto-renew plus a 94% loaded line and no buffer rules out switch and deferral: either can interrupt deliveries. A plain incumbent renewal is stable (c1) but does not address the 18% spend cut. Renegotiation at renewal previously moved price and payment terms without a vendor change (c4); multi-year volume pricing also cut unit cost without narrowing scope (c6). That path is the only single decision that can lower TCO while not adding delivery risk. Verify c4 to see how large the prior recovery actually was before treating 18% as achievable. Outcome of the ask remains uncertain.
